mapper.select: SELECT d.target_version AS version, d.status, p.id AS package_id, p.package_name, t.id AS task_id, t.task_name, p.package_type, p.file_size, p.sha256, d.finish_time AS installed_at, CASE WHEN d.command_time IS NOT NULL AND d.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT( TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.command_time, d.finish_time), ' 分钟' ) ELSE NULL END AS duration_text, t.operator, t.rollback_enabled, t.remark FROM remote_upgrade_task_device d JOIN remote_upgrade_task t ON d.task_id = t.id JOIN remote_upgrade_package p ON t.package_id = p.id WHERE d.target_device_id = #{targetDeviceId} AND d.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY d.finish_time DESC

SELECT d.target_version AS version, d.status, p.id AS package_id, p.package_name, t.id AS task_id, t.task_name, p.package_type, p.file_size, p.sha256, d.finish_time AS installed_at, CASE WHEN d.command_time IS NOT NULL AND d.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT( TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.command_time, d.finish_time), ' 分钟' ) ELSE NULL END AS duration_text, t.operator, t.rollback_enabled, t.remark FROM remote_upgrade_task_device d JOIN remote_upgrade_task t ON d.task_id = t.id JOIN remote_upgrade_package p ON t.package_id = p.id WHERE d.target_device_id = #{targetDeviceId} AND d.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY d.finish_time DESC LIMIT 1
